plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'School Library Media Center Certificate' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 28, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6824/PublishedPdf). This is a Certificate of Achievement (a grade of C or better is required in each major course). Official Total Units: 27 = 13+14, verified against the map's 13 / 14 headers. LIBT 100 Introduction to Library and Information Technology has no unit value printed in the map's Semester 1 row; it is 1 unit per the official SCC course listing, which makes the Semester 1 sum 1+2+1+3+3+3 = 13 exactly. In-plan prereqs sequenced (all with grades of C or better): LIBT 300 requires LIBT 100; LIBT 330, LIBT 333, LIBT 343, and LIBT 345 each require LIBT 100 & LIBT 300 (or current enrollment in both, documented per the map note); LIBT 331 requires LIBT 100, 300, and 330; LIBT 348 requires LIBT 100, 300, 330, 331, and 343. The map's corequisite note (^) states LIBT 100 & LIBT 300 can be taken at the same time; LIBT 100 is included in LIBT 300's prereq array with the concurrent option documented in its choice note. The modeled path uses the first-listed option for the ME slot: LIBT 325 (3) rather than LIBR 325. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
